svg.title: The creative process: five stages that interrupt one another
svg.desc: Five triangles made of smaller triangles stand in a row: preparation, incubation, insight, evaluation and elaboration. A dashed line joins them in the order textbooks give. Curved arrows run back against that order between the middle three stages: from insight to incubation, from evaluation to insight and from evaluation to incubation, so the stages interrupt one another instead of following a strict sequence. Original course diagram after Csikszentmihalyi (1996, chap. 4).
